title: Anatole Probable NDE 3982
content: When I decided to give up trying to reach the shore and just let myself drown, suddenly everything seemed to stand totally still. I could clearly feel/see that the wind still blew, the water still lapped around me, the sun continued to shine bright and strong. I could feel these elements but they did not affect the void time/space that was created around me. Then I heard a voice directly in my mind. I clearly perceived that it came to me from above-left side. This being I did not perceive as being 'more' than myself. It was more like a 'similar' to myself. A telepathic dialogue took place in which certain questions were asked and I was compelled to answer truthfully. At the end, I made a decision and at that point, the 'void' stopped and, with difficulty, I made it back to the shore.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A 'void time/space' was created around him in which everything 'seemed to stand totally still' while wind/water/sun continued but did not affect the void.

arrival.other_being_detail: A voice/being perceived telepathically from the 'above-left side', described as 'similar' to himself (not 'more' than himself).

environment.environment_other_detail: A time/space 'void' in which everything stood still and external elements did not affect it.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: After making a decision, the 'void' stopped and he returned to shore 'with difficulty'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning while trying to reach shore.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Time/space 'void' with everything standing still; telepathic dialogue with an unknown being/voice; then return to shore after making a decision.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/light/life review described; instead an abrupt 'void' and telepathic questioning followed by a decision and return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A localized 'void time/space' where external elements (wind, water, sun) were perceived but did not affect the void; the being was described as 'similar' to the experiencer and not 'more' than him; compelled to answer truthfully in telepathic dialogue.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “suddenly everything seemed to stand totally still.” “Then I heard a voice directly in my mind.” “This being I did not perceive as being 'more' than myself. It was more like a 'similar' to myself.” “I was compelled to answer truthfully.”
